quality_gates.description: Thresholds for the target scope. A key that is not listed here is ignored by the scripts, which is why unknown keys are rejected: a typo would silently restore the built-in default.

tooling.description: Only when the pom declares no version, or its version cannot read the class files of the JDK in use. A value here overrides the pom, and prepare-agent must run the same JaCoCo version as the report goal.

freshness_days.description: Legacy mode (without --interactive) refuses to freeze a target whose last commit is younger than this many days. Default 7.

instruction_paths.description: Extra repository instruction files the context pack includes in REPO CONVENTIONS, relative to the repo root; may live outside .github. An `applyTo` front-matter is honoured.

maven_timeout_seconds.description: How long ONE maven call may take before the check gives up with a clear error. Default 600 (10 min), deliberately short: the answer to a slow check is a faster build (maven_also_make false after an install, maven_args such as -T 1C, a narrower target), not a longer wait. Raise it only when you accept runs that take that long.

maven_also_make.description: When a test run adds Maven's -am (also build the target module's dependencies). Omit it for "auto": build only the target's module, and add -am only if maven says the dependencies are missing - fast in a big reactor, still correct in a small repo or a fresh clone. true always adds it (modules that change constantly); false never does (you run mvn -DskipTests install yourself and own that decision).

maven_skip_main_compile.description: When a check may run against the classes already in <module>/target/classes instead of compiling src/main first (-Dmaven.main.skip=true). Omit it for "auto": compile when a source under src/main is newer than those classes (the build really is out of date, and the check says it may take minutes), skip when it is not - the production code does not change during a run, and in a module with annotation processors or generated sources that compile is a full rebuild every time. true always skips when classes exist and only warns about staleness; false always compiles.

maven_args.description: Extra flags added to every maven call, e.g. ["-o"] for offline, ["-T", "1C"] for a parallel build, ["-DskipITs"]. Use them to make a slow multi-module build finish in time.

test_data_paths.description: Files that list example business values for this system (a customer id is 9 digits, an account number looks like X, the transfer types that are plain strings). The context pack includes them verbatim as TEST DATA, and the planner reads them before asking a human anything - that is how you stop repeating the same answers run after run. Any readable text or markdown file, relative to the repo root.
